title: Adopt a Tree
subtitle: Help preserve the Atlantic Forest in Pontal do Paraná.
fauna_flora_title: Flora and Fauna of Pontal do Paraná
fauna_flora_description: The Pontal do Paraná region is home to a rich biodiversity of the Atlantic Forest, with native tree species such as the Yellow Ipê and the Quaresmeira, which are vital to the local ecosystem. The fauna is equally rich, including several species of birds, small mammals, and insects that depend on the forest for survival.
